description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Stasis and Illustrious Wanderglyph trigger.
Resolve the Illustrious Wanderglyph trigger, creating a 1/1 Gnome artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Gnome, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Repeat during each of your turns.
As long as Stasis is on the battlefield, players skip their untap steps.
